# Variable `QB_MEM`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

The QB_MEM variable controls the amount of memory allocated to the emulated machine. Specify as follows:

```
QB_MEM = "-m 512"

```

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-QB_MEM)
